purpose: Focused literature/design review; not a systematic review, training receipt, or performance result for HPC v2

sources.title: Transfer learning promotes acquisition of individual BCI skills
sources.finding: Adaptive versus fixed CSP and supervised first-online-run calibration were already studied.

sources.title: Correction to: Transfer learning promotes acquisition of individual BCI skills
sources.finding: Corrects numerical CSP comparison values; cite with original.

sources.title: Regularizing Common Spatial Patterns to Improve BCI Designs: Unified Theory and New Algorithms
sources.finding: Regularized CSP is established prior art; covariance/source regularization alone does not establish novelty.

sources.title: Transfer Learning for Brain–Computer Interfaces: A Euclidean Space Data Alignment Approach
sources.finding: EA averages trial covariances and whitens signal; target information scope must match when used as comparator.

sources.title: Riemannian Procrustes Analysis: Transfer Learning for Brain–Computer Interfaces
sources.finding: Identified as geometry-aware transfer prior art; no reproduced performance or full-method claim here.

sources.title: Explicit Inductive Bias for Transfer Learning with Convolutional Networks
sources.finding: Source-parameter-centred quadratic regularization is an existing method; weak source fitting can limit its benefit.

sources.title: Benchmarking brain–computer interface algorithms: Riemannian approaches vs convolutional neural networks
sources.finding: Multi-dataset and cross-session comparisons motivate classical as well as neural controls; do not generalize one weak EEGNet setting.

sources.title: Fine-Tuning Strategies for Continual Online EEG Motor Imagery Decoding: Insights from a Large-Scale Longitudinal Study
sources.finding: Already compares causal independent/sequential fine-tuning and online alignment on a 61-participant longitudinal dataset. Current support-label protocol is different.

sources.title: Transfer learning for EEG-based BCIs: a comparative evaluation and optimization of data alignment methods
sources.finding: Attention, not MI, dataset; abstract explicitly distinguishes optimized oracle parameter results from leakage-free evaluation. Context only, not a core MI comparator.

sources.title: Deep Cholesky space adaptation for cross-session motor imagery decoding
sources.finding: October 2026 bibliographic record verified; publisher full-text request returned 403. No implementation/performance or novelty-exclusion conclusion from unread methods.

sources.title: EEG dataset and OpenBMI toolbox for three BCI paradigms: an investigation into BCI illiteracy
sources.finding: 54 participants, two days, 62 EEG plus four EMG channels, 1000 Hz; 100 offline MI trials/session and separate online data.

sources.title: Supporting data for EEG Dataset and OpenBMI Toolbox for Three BCI Paradigms
sources.finding: Dataset rights confirmed from DataCite; article CC BY and toolbox GPL-3.0 are different scopes.

sources.title: MOABB Lee2019_MI dataset documentation
sources.finding: Default labeled MI access uses train_run; test_run lacks MI labels and defaults false. Must not assume online labels or multiple labeled runs.

sources.title: BCI Competition 2008 – Graz data set A / BNCI 001-2014
sources.finding: Nine participants, two sessions, six runs/session, 48 four-class trials/run, 22 EEG and three EOG, 250 Hz. Binary left/right gives 24 trials/run before exclusions. Competition-time hidden labels require current released-label verification.

implementation_alignment.task_count_caveat: Neural tasks additionally fit support-adaptation arms; 18 is a source-fit count, not the total optimizer-run count.
implementation_alignment.old_54_reason: Incompatible with new pure-PyTorch CompactEEGNet architecture; preserve historical accepted models and results.
implementation_alignment.external_status: separate data staging and implementation required; proposed protocols are not executable current tasks
implementation_alignment.fixed_strength_rule: alpha=n_support/(n_support+tau), with fixed tau; alpha itself varies by support count
implementation_alignment.matched_fixed_weight_ablation: ea_empirical_anchored_csp versus ea_anchored_csp; same EA/current support and fixed budget
implementation_alignment.alignment_ablation: ea_empirical_anchored_csp versus empirical_anchored_csp; same empirical weighting rule
